guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, alerts_q[0] is asynchronously set to 1'b0.
On rising edge of clk_i when rst_ni is high, alerts_q[0] samples alerts[0].
guarantees.cond: rst_ni is high and posedge clk_i

assumptions.claim: alerts[0] must meet setup and hold timing relative to clk_i to avoid metastability in alerts_q[0].
assumptions.cond: every posedge clk_i when rst_ni is high
assumptions.risk: Metastability could cause downstream logic to see an undefined value, potentially missing or falsely reporting the alert.

uncertain_points.claim: A single flop samples alerts[0], which may be asynchronous; a transition near clk_i edge can cause metastability in alerts_q[0] on the first clock cycle.
uncertain_points.cond: alerts[0] transition close to clk_i rising edge, with no further synchronization stages visible in this chunk
uncertain_points.risk: Metastable state could be interpreted as a valid high/low, leading to missed alert escalation or spurious security response.
